notes: Curated candidates for the adhan library. `evaluate` verifies every Commons licence, measures audio quality against the gate in scripts/adhan/lib.mjs and records the verdict; `build` masters only voices that are enabled AND pass. Excluded entries are kept with their reason so the decision is auditable.

excluded.commons: File:Adhan, Great Mosque of Mecca - Jan 21, 2013.webm
excluded.reason: Removed after listening feedback and rights review: a visitor's phone video of the live Masjid al-Haram muezzin. The muezzin's performer rights (the Haram muezzins are appointed by the General Presidency for the Affairs of the Two Holy Mosques) are unresolved, and the capture is reverberant and amateur. Needs written permission — see content/adhan/PERMISSIONS_NEEDED.md.
Removed: field recording by a visitor; the performer's consent to the 'own work' licence cannot be verified, and the capture is not professional quality.

Removed: the uploader account (Adam-synagda) was blocked indefinitely on Commons for 'Abusing multiple accounts' (verified in the block log) and also imported other people's images, so its 'own work, CC0' claim is not reliable.
Same class of problem: uploader account blocked for abusing multiple accounts.

Licence cannot be verified: a 2014 third-party copy of a Freesound upload (claimed CC BY 3.0). The Freesound original has since been deleted, and Commons volunteers never reviewed the licence. Audio quality is excellent (clean, −53 dBFS floor) — it can be added if the rights holder or a reviewer confirms the licence.
